name: Cascade Biotech Biometric Scan Gloves
description:
Medical-grade gloves with embedded biometric sensors across all ten fingertips. Touching a patient provides instant readings — pulse, blood oxygen, skin conductivity, temperature, and basic toxicology screening through dermal micro-sampling. Data streams to a connected display or AR overlay in real time.

Used by field medics, triage teams, and the kind of back-alley clinicians who can't afford dedicated scanning equipment. A single touch tells you if someone is dying and roughly what's killing them.
functionality: Contact biometric scanning, toxicology screening, real-time data streaming
what_it_says: You diagnose people by touching them, which is either reassuring or terrifying depending on the context.
story_hooks: A field medic's Biometric Scan Gloves record a patient's vitals showing a heartbeat pattern that matches no known human cardiac rhythm — but the patient appears perfectly healthy.
